The trade whipsawed hard (roughly -56 to +81pts) in a repeating chop pattern rather than trending decisively against the entry -- every adverse excursion stayed within the range already seen and was followed by a recovery back through zero into favorable territory (peaks at +32, +53, +81, +64, +41, +30), so nothing ever confirmed a one-way wrong-direction move.
